Comparison summary (fixed usage basis)

  • Estimated monthly cost: Claude Haiku 5.5 ¥11.00 vs Kimi K3 ¥327.60 on a common CNY basis (list prices $1.64 / ¥327.60) — at this fixed usage, Claude Haiku 5.5 is cheaper by ¥316.6/month.
  • Cost ratio: under this basis, Kimi K3 costs about 29.8× Claude Haiku 5.5 (Claude Haiku 5.5 is ~97% cheaper). The ratio holds only at the current list prices, reference rate and fixed usage assumptions; it says nothing about capability, output quality or overall value.
  • Input unit price (off-peak / single-price basis): list prices $0.1 vs ¥20; after conversion Claude Haiku 5.5 is lower (by ≈ ¥19.33/1M tokens).
  • Output unit price (off-peak / single-price basis): list prices $0.5 vs ¥100; after conversion Claude Haiku 5.5 is lower (by ≈ ¥96.64/1M tokens).
  • Cache-hit price (off-peak basis): Claude Haiku 5.5 $0.01; Kimi K3 ¥2.
  • Currencies: Claude Haiku 5.5 is billed in USD, Kimi K3 in CNY; conversion uses the CFETS central parity rate (see above) and is indicative only.
  • Context window: identical at 1024K.
  • Modalities: identical — Text, Image understanding.
  • Price sources: Anthropic official pricing (verified 2026-10-28), Alibaba Cloud Model Studio — Kimi K3 model page (verified 2026-10-28); unit: official list price per 1M tokens (Claude Haiku 5.5 in USD, Kimi K3 in CNY; cross-currency figures converted to CNY as noted above).

These are computations from published list prices under fixed call volume, token usage, cache assumptions and billing rules. They are not rankings of capability, output quality or overall value, and do not constitute purchase advice.
